comments.value: If this issue is still occurring now to anyone please note the avatar id, rough date + time you uploaded (with timezone or in UTC) and how long it took from your perspective

been having this the past few days, takes anywhere from 30 seconds to multiple minutes before changes are pushed. if i dont change avatar after its updated, so i am still on an older version, i appear as an error robot to new joins as well

@{667353ba8663454809d39116|full_name} It is happening to multiple avatars of mine. One I updated last night at about 10pm est and it still has not updated 12hrs later. I will note I have updated the cc and sdk but still am having issues.

Can confirm it's still happening

ID: avtr_b5db68f3-ba05-42e4-8d8d-b2b1279975fe

Upload date: Sep. 19 2024, 15:30 UTC

@{60651324fbe2815d2b9ff6cb|full_name}: up to a minute is what I'd consider normal, multiple minutes is a bit longer than expected, could you share the other details I asked for so I can review things from our side

@{62940a387a1f370b771abc99|full_name}: In this case it's completely my fault, I went to sleep thinking I left enough capacity for the server side processing but when I woke up noticed quite a bit of backlog, I increased capacity temporarily to clear this backlog a couple hours ago. Sorry about that
same avatar but at 18:51:33 utc, took about 30 mins

I had something slightly different happen that I haven't seen anyone else mention. My upload worked fine at first, then when I moved servers, I was back in the old version of my avatar. Some time later it finally updated.
@{62631568add97b529ca0cbc7|full_name}: could you provide the avatar id and rough time you observed this?
@{60651324fbe2815d2b9ff6cb|full_name}: so yesterday I checked and it was processed well within a minute so I suspect maybe caching is affecting things. For today it was an accidental backlog build up

General heads up I spent a good bit of time today building out logic to ensure new uploads have priority when it comes to being processed so even if a backlog occurs that it does not affect new uploads, this is not complete just yet but I hope to get it out soon
This change is now out, new uploads have priority in being processed

@{667353ba8663454809d39116|full_name} 

I believe that VRChat official should make announcements regarding a series of avatar related issues, such as this issue and high rate of becoming an error avatar.

Even though it is already beyond the minor issue, I have not seen any official announcement and instead have only seen unofficial announcements by Tony.

Also, users expect immediate availability after uploading, and that should not be disturbed.

Ideally, it should be immediately available, but no longer than 5 minutes at most to wait until it is ready to be used. (In that case, it would be helpful to have an indication that Security Check is in progress.)

この問題やエラーアバターになりやすい問題などの問題に関して、公式でアナウンスするべきだと強く感じます。

既に小規模な問題の範疇を超えているにもかかわらず、私は公式のアナウンスを見掛けておらず、代わりにTony氏による非公式案内だけ見かけています。

また、ユーザーはアップロード後にすぐに利用出来ることを期待しています。それは妨げるべきではありません。

理想的には即時ですが、待機するなら長くても5分程度であるべきでしょう。(その場合はSecurity Check中であることを示す表示があると良いですね。)

comments.value: I feel like this has been getting worse and worse, some days it can take up to 15 minutes or more for VRC's servers to realize I updated my avatar

I've been continuing to tune things to ensure server side processing time is minimised, unless the avatar is particularly big it'll be processed in under 20 seconds. In this upcoming release there will be changes to further this as much as possible bringing this to a completion point
This is now considered complete with 2024.4.2

details:
After this most recent update that came out, updating your avatar in unity does not update it in vrchat for long periods of time. 

After you update you avatar upload in unity, vrchat does not reflect the change for a long time. Not sure why this occurs now but it didn't happen before.
title: Updating uploaded avatars not updating in-game for long periods of time
